RegulatoryStatus: JEMA Gras (#2085) Approved by FDA for food use (21 CFR 172.515)
ListedBy: Listed by the Council of Europe at a level of 60 ppm (except for chewing gum)
JournalData: Isoamyl Isovalerate is prepared by direct esterification of isoamyl alcohol with isovaleric acid under azeotropic conditions.
Source: S. Circtander, Perfume and Flavor Chemicals (Aroma Chemicals), Vol. 1, no. 229, S. Circtander, Montclair, NJ (1969); cited by D.L.J. Opdyke, Food Cosmet. Toxicol. 7 89 (19 ).
Noticity: Both the acute oral LD50 value in rats and the acute dermal LD50 value of isoamyl isovalerate in rabbits exceeded 5 g/kg.
Report: O.M. Moreno, Report to RIFM, Aug. 2, 1976; cited by Opdyke, op. cit.
